essence: The supreme breath-control is the one that is devoid and without embryo.
Practice should continue until the highest quality is attained.
Pratyāhāra is prescribed as the forceful withdrawal of the senses from their objects.
Dhāraṇā is declared to be the holding of the breath-wind.
Dhyāna is called the meditation on desired deities within the self.
